How to move an image lower in a sidebar (as shown on the picture)

You can use ::before and ::after almost anywhere. They're very useful. Here's a snippet that puts the image directly under "/v/dpdr":

h1.whoaversename {
 line-height: 1.5;
}

h1.whoaversename::after {
 content: url("https://i.sli.mg/u98rTL.jpg");
}

Keep in mind that you can only have one ::before and one ::after on each element and the added content will share certain properties with the "real" element, such as linking to a URL.
